story: When I asked for my September 2026 wages of Rs 17,000, my supervisor slapped me and his men pushed me out of the factory gate in Faridabad. They said they will break my legs if I come back.

timeline.event: User asked for September 2026 wages of Rs 17,000.
timeline.user_words: When I asked for my September 2026 wages of Rs 17,000...

timeline.event: User was assaulted and pushed out of the factory gate by supervisor and his men.
timeline.user_words: my supervisor slapped me and his men pushed me out of the factory gate in Faridabad. They said they will break my legs if I come back.

evidence: Physical assault and threats of violence by supervisor and his men
facts.user_goal: Recover unpaid wages of Rs 17,000 for September 2026 and seek justice for the assault and threats.

messages: Your safety comes first. If you are in danger now, call 112. Women can also call 181. Keep any proof (photos, messages). When you are safe, free legal aid on 15100 can help with both the violence and the money.
आपकी सुरक्षा सबसे ज़रूरी है। अभी खतरा हो तो 112 पर कॉल करें। महिलाएँ 181 पर भी कॉल कर सकती हैं। सुरक्षित होने पर 15100 पर मुफ़्त कानूनी मदद लें।
